title: Mastery of Specialization
summary: The Master of Specialization cycles through spells that test the raid's adaptability.
overview: The Master of Specialization cycles through spells that test the raid's adaptability.

abilities.name: Specialization spell cycle
abilities.summary: A repeating sequence of eight spells.
description: Imprecision, Searing Pain, Rigidity, Chilling Agony, Curse of Misfortune, Glimmering Aura, Impurity and Toxic Blast are cast in order.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Prepare for a new spell in the scripted rotation every twenty-five seconds.
Adjust damage and support as each effect changes which tools are effective.
Maintain tank healing throughout the alternating weakening and damaging casts.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 2.
